notes: v0.3.24 - the agent can work with your chats: search what was said inside them, rename them, and file them into folders (it shows you which ones it would move first). Folders appear in the sidebar, and chats are grouped Today / Yesterday / This week / This month / Last month / Older. "Shut down everything" now really stops the app - it had quietly done nothing on Docker for months while reporting success. Messages you have to act on stay until you close them, and the update notice appears on its own again in the installed app.
